|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Blizzard 2 (V) (Virtual Set 4)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “May add 1 pilot and 8 passengers. Immune to attrition < 4. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Once during your control phase, may ▲ Trample or Walker Barrage. Adds 2 to Walker Barrage at same site, which need not target a weapon and may not randomly select Jedi.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “May add 1 pilot and 8 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. During your control phase, may take one Trample or Walker Barrage into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Walker Barrage total is +2. Immune to attrition < 4.” '''What changed:''' removed “Immune to attrition < 4.”; “Once during” → “During”; “▲” → “take one”; “Barrage. Adds 2 to” → “Barrage into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”; “at same site, which need not target a weapon and may not randomly select Jedi.” → “total is +2. Immune to attrition < 4.”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153629/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards4.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 3, slip 29. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Blizzard 2]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth#Cards|Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
